localizedValues.name: G1-South Pool Group
localizedValues.description: The smaller group use area adjacent to Lake Kookanusa. Has shower building, flush toilet, two outhouses and picnic shelter. Private swim area fills up depending on Koocanusa Lake levels.    All Weddings must advise Park Facility Operators : info@ekparks.com or (250) 422-3003. Thanks!

localizedValues.name: G2-Ponderosa Group
localizedValues.description: The picnic shelter at this groupsite will not be available for use for the 2024 season. Previously known as North Pool Group Use area, this groupsite has four outhouses and a very large lawn area. Private swimming area fills up depending on Koocanusa Lake levels. A shower building is available in the adjacent Ponderosa Campground.
